paragraphs: The Bolas Rider is the Mapuche unique mounted archer in Age of Empires. Armed with weighted cords, this rider combines ranged attacks with the mobility of a horse.
It is strong against mounted units, but foot archers, skirmishers and enemies that reach close range can threaten it.
Its charged attack slows enemy units, making their movement harder to control. With Malon researched, its projectiles also deal pass-through damage.
These abilities reward positioning and can disrupt an approaching army. In these battles, the elite rider must turn that control into a victory with equal resources.
